[P J O’Rourke](http://online.wsj.com/article/SB10001424052748704050204576218600999993800.html) on the evil of cities congested by bikes and bike lanes:

> *The bicycle is a parody of a wheeled vehicle—a donkey cart without the cart, where you do the work of the donkey.*
